description:
Function : 
 Intuitive is an exciting growth business environment requiring talented technical professionals to support and scale our global supply chain operations. The Data Engineer role supports the Staff Business Process Architect by developing automated workflows, technical solutions, and analytics capabilities that enable consistent best practice usage of tools and processes across Supplier Engineering operations.
 This role works closely with the Business Process Architect and cross-functional stakeholders to build and maintain the automation infrastructure that drives scalability and operational excellence in our world-class supply chain.
 Roles and Responsibilities : 
 Process Automation Development
 Develop and maintain automated workflows for core supplier engineering processes including supplier selection, qualification, purchased part validation, supplier change control management, and supplier capacity management

 Build automation solutions that support process enhancements and operational efficiency improvements

 Create scalable automation frameworks that accommodate interdependencies of existing applications and processes

 Support implementation of process and system enhancement projects by developing required automation components

 
 Data Management & Analytics
 Develop and maintain Tableau dashboards for supplier engineering metrics, action management, and regulatory compliance tracking

 Build predictive analytics capabilities with exception alarms to support supplier engineering operations

 Ensure data integrity and connectivity across ERP, supplier management platforms, planning systems, and other enterprise applications

 Create custom reports and automated data pipelines to reduce dependencies on external teams

 
 Supplier Collaboration Automation

 Develop workflows and technical configurations for supplier collaboration systems

 Build automated processes for material flow management for NPI and sustaining purchased parts

 Create automation solutions that support supplier change requests, validation requests, PPQP, and supplier corrective action processes

 Implement incoming quality control integrations and validation support systems

 System Support & Maintenance

 Provide ongoing technical support for business applications used in supplier engineering operations

 Maintain and validate existing dashboards, reports, and automated processes

 Support business process documentation through technical system blueprints and user requirement specifications

 Collaborate with analysts and project managers to troubleshoot and enhance existing automation solutions

 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or related field

 3+ years developing automated workflows and business process solutions

 Proficiency with Large Language Models (LLMs) for development work and application integration

 Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)

 Experience with workflow automation platforms (Airflow, Microsoft Power Automate)

 Strong SQL skills and data analysis experience

 Understanding of supply chain and supplier management processes

 Experience with ERP systems and enterprise applications

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Manufacturing or regulated industry experience

 Knowledge of supplier qualification and quality management processes

 Programming skills in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages

 Experience with predictive analytics and statistical modeling

 Six Sigma certification

 Experience reducing operational dependencies through automation

 Key Competencies 
 Process-oriented thinking with attention to detail

 Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions

 Innovative use of AI/LLM tools to accelerate development and enhance application capabilities

 Collaborative approach to problem solving

 Continuous improvement mindset

 Adaptability in fast-paced environment

 
 
 Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19.  Details can vary by role.
 Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.
 Mandatory Notices 
 U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer:  In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.
 Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).  
 For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. 
 We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.
 Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee.
 This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on

business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.
 Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:
 Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com.
 We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target compensation ranges are listed.
